title: Fear
spec: Get out of the ring round the light.

say: This is your swimmer, seen from above: the
board is its body, its front to the right.
Where you put a part is where it sits.
Parts holds what you build with: eyes read
the light, thrusters push. The (i) on a row
says what the part does.
The bar on the left opens the drawers: Parts,
Tools, Files, Sense, Navigator. At its foot:
Settings, Chapters, and Run, which sets the
swimmer going.
The faint shapes show where each part goes
and which way it points. Drag an Eye from
Parts onto this cell.
It looks forward, but this eye must look
back and to the left: press Turn left, or L,
twice. It turns by 60 degrees each time.
Now the second eye, on this cell: pick the
Eye in Parts, or press 1, and click here.
This one looks back and to the right:
press Turn right, or R, twice.
Thrusters push the way they point, forward
already. Put one on this cell...
...and the other one here.
Wire each eye to the thruster on its own
side: take Wire, or W, and drag from the
upper eye to the upper thruster.
Then from the lower eye to the lower
thruster.
The light is on the swimmer's right.
Press Run, or Space, and watch.
The run waits for you. Under the arena: start
again, play or pause, a step, fast forward;
then the timeline: click it to go to any time.
Objectives: what the level asks, each with
its bar. Here, get out of the ring round the
light before the time runs out.
Inside: the swimmer's wiring, live. Beads
flow along the wires, the faster the more
light an eye reads.
Press Play, or Space. The right eye sees the
light and drives the right thruster: the
swimmer turns away and flees.
That is fear, Braitenberg's vehicle 2a. Each
win is scored on its time and its parts: a
point in Score. Fewer of either is better;
the line joins the wins no other beats.
Close, then Next level when you are ready.
